book.name: 2 KORINTA
book.title: 2 Korinta Yeisu ana totugugunayao Korinta goiadi leta aiyuwoina

content: Paulo kidi idi paisewa dedevina
Moe pasina nukotoma geya itopeta unana ame ama kawoi Yaubada ina nuwokapisi goi inumisema ivinima kaguuinuwe, tauna nukotoma geya itopeta.

Go sem guinuwagau be guinuwa aba omayamaya kakataedi. Nakae pola o Yaubada ina livala ana sobala geya, go sem tomota matadi goi kabóbwara moitamo, e bei tomota liliumi matami goi kakamoitamoema bei koyagoima Yaubada matana goi ima guinuwa dedevina.
E nakona tomota maniyedi Vala Dedevina kataalavaite geya siyagoiyeta go, moe kidi vailai ana kenao goi sinonoina aditava nuwodi ma taabodaidi geya siyagoiyeta.

Amo tauyadi geya sinumiseta. Poyapoya ame ina basaleliu nuwodi ivapatudi, e mavada Vala Dedevina goi geya sigiteyeta. Vala Dedevinayana ame manuna: Guyau moe Yaubada ina togaga ana káeyana, Tauyana Yaubada ana tapata.
Moitamo. Moe toinima yoima geya katalavaiteyeta geya, go sem Yeisu Guyau katalavaite bego Tauyana Tomoya go, aiyuwoina bego kai komi imi pakonayao Yeisu pasina

unana Yaubada kina idigo kana, ‘Mamaníwana goi mavada bei itapasigi.’ Tauna moe Tauyana nakae nuwoma itapasigidi, e bei itoboinema ina togaga ana káeyana kayagoi; aeyanayana Yeisu Guyau maisina goi itapasígina.
Paulo ina neneta goi Yaubada ina togaga isowóduwo

E Vala Dedevinayana ana mavada esaesa nakae kai sakavaima neenetaidi vaega nakae sinaema goi ikaaiyaka. Ikaiyaka bego tomota siyagoi togagayana yaima goi moe Yaubada ina togaga gagaina toina go, geya kai ima togaga geya.
Ame nakae: Mou liliudi kababanedi go, togagayana pasina mama kaba siya. Tuta maniyena geya kayagoiyeta bei manakaema kaguinuwe go, luluma geya sitameyeta.
Tomota siyogedegedema go, Yaubada geya ikalavemeta. Madi láuwo sivatupuwema go, geya sikaumatemeta.
Tuta liliuna Yeisu ina kámasa wowoma goi kaalotowo bego Yeisu yawoina nakae wowoma goi ivagitakoe.
Moe moitamo. Kai maa yawoima tuta liliuna tomota siyooisima be Yeisu pasina sitaagonema ámasa yaina. Moe nakae bego Yeisu yawoina wowoma kaavavaidi goi nakae kavagitakoe.
Tauna ámasa kai yaima goi ipaaisewa go, yawana vata yaimi goi ipaaisewa o tadigo kada, ‘Kai Yeisu ina vamoleyanayao gedageda kabaabanedi bego komi yawoimi vata kobabane.’
E kai togínina tayamo Gínina Kimaasabaina goi nakae igini kana,
‘Anumisa, tauna nakae atalavaita.’ Same 116:10
Amo tauyana ina numisa unana moe Baloma Kimaasabaina, e kai ima numisa nakae. Tuwo kanumisa, tauna kai nakae Vala Dedevina kataalavaite
unana kayagoi bego kina Yaubada ida Tomoya Yeisu ámasa goi ikaitáoe, tauna kai nakae ámasa goi Yeisu taiyao bei ikaitaoema, komi taiyao toinina matana goi ivataoeda.
Bogina koyagoi. Gedagedayadi liliudi moe komi manumi bego Yaubada ina kanuwóiya ibibíbina tomota badabadaidi yaidi; anuwoiyayana bei tomota idi kauyagu ivaituwe. Moe Yaubada ana taimámina manuna.
Tauna nukotoma geya itopeta, go sem nakona wowoda sidaudáura go, maliyalina tamo tamo nuwoda Yaubada iyoolimedi.
Ima nuwonúwana bego ima mou ame tuta moe kaakapudi be nakae tuta kaakupina goi kalootowoidi go, sikatubayasima bei Yaubada ana káeyana tomoeeyalina vaatayaina kalotowo. Ame mouyadi idedevinasavedi

unana kai geya kanuwonuwoneta dogoi taagitedi manudi, go sem dogoi geya taagitedi manudi kanuwonúwana. Dogoiyadi taagitedi, tuta kaakupina kaka goi sikaaiyaka, e sisáwala go, dogoiyadi geya taagitedi sikaiyako vata.
